integrity: The determinant is derived from the published Montesinos determinant formula and checked symbolically. Nonsquareness is an infinite proof using coprimality and reduction modulo 3; finite computation is only a sanity check.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the sign-normalized half-line of Nakamura Example 3.1 beginning at parameter minus one. No claim is made about all signed variants, concordance order, or whether determinant detects equivalence classes of delta-move sites.
title: Determinant growth and nonsliceness in a two-site delta-unknotting family
